claim: Valid TIFF/EXIF layouts return no resolution when rational values precede the directory or share an offset.
evidence: read_rational_resolution skips every offset behind the current stream position. An in-memory TIFF with XResolution and YResolution both pointing to the same 300/1 rational returned nil: reading X advances past the shared offset, so Y is skipped. A TIFF with separate 300/1 rationals before its IFD also returned nil.

claim: A short JFIF segment raises an uncaught NoMethodError even with the default failure-handling options.
evidence: An APP0 segment with length 7 and payload "JFIF\0" passes the identifier check, then data[7].ord raises NoMethodError. Calling FastImage.resolution with this in-memory JPEG reproduced the exception; FastImage#fetch does not rescue NoMethodError.

claim: The new syntax prevents the library from loading on Ruby versions still allowed by the gem specification.
evidence: fastimage.gemspec declares required_ruby_version >= 1.9.2, but Exif#initialize now uses keyword-argument syntax requiring Ruby 2.0, and jpeg.rb:51 uses safe navigation requiring Ruby 2.3. lib/fastimage/fastimage.rb unconditionally requires both parsers, so requiring fastimage on those older permitted runtimes fails with SyntaxError before any API can run.
